word processing software being used. Some candidates resaved the file in RTF format and occasionally the

of the folder contents after saving provides the evidence required.

7:
An existing table within the text was to be formatted as per the illustration in the paper. The activity was
generally well executed. Common errors included the top row text not centred over the five columns on the
right, text not rotated or aligned as shown, the table not fitted within the column and the gridlines not bold
when printed. Rarely observed was splitting of text when column width was adjusted.

and not limited to the two regions. Data entry for the two axis titles was not always accurate, although the
title for the chart usually was present and accurate. Data values were not always displayed on or above the
individual bars.

missed these. Proof reading and document organisation presented a challenge in this paper. Many
candidates did not observe that the lists, especially the first one, would split over the page or column if they

‘wizard’. Some evidence for making the form ‘user friendly’ was expected, such as a meaningful title, user

was not what the question specified.
